# Documentation Instructions

## Core Requirements

### README Updates
- Update README.md when behavior changes
- Include clear installation and usage instructions
- Document all major features and configuration options
- Maintain current screenshots and examples

### Pattern Documentation
- Add screenshot for each pattern
- Document purpose and intended use cases
- Include usage notes and implementation examples
- Provide accessibility notes and considerations
- Document any dependencies or requirements

### Changelog Maintenance
- Maintain CHANGELOG.md entries for all user-visible changes
- Use semantic versioning principles
- Include breaking changes, new features, and bug fixes
- Date entries and provide clear descriptions

## Documentation Structure

### Organization
- Keep documentation close to code
- Link from README.md to pattern/block documentation
- Maintain docs/ folder with current content
- Cross-link related guides and references

### Content Requirements
- Include code samples and examples
- Provide file tree structures where relevant
- Add quickstart sections for common tasks
- Document configuration options and customization
- Include troubleshooting guides

### Developer Documentation
- Document APIs and hooks
- Provide development setup instructions
- Include contribution guidelines
- Document testing procedures and requirements
